attempts.summary: Built an Ansible project on node1 that creates a "Fleet Internal CA", issues a node2 TLS certificate (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2/IP:10.100.75.11), configures node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 via a systemd-managed TLS service, and installs the CA as a trusted system CA on both node1 and node2. Verified cross-node HTTPS trust in both directions, then completed the mandatory boot-identity restart/recovery protocol on all three managed nodes.
